bug.title: Text of versions still in moderation is served publicly by /text and /compare
bug.symptoms: The checks pipeline now extracts a version's paragraphs when it enters moderation (checks/pipeline.py _TRIGGER_STATES = {"moderation", "listed"}), before any moderator has approved it GET /v1/papers/{id}/v/{n}/text (reading/router.py get_paper_text) and GET /v1/papers/{id}/compare resolve any version the node holds and never check its state, so anyone can read the full text of an unlisted (in-moderation, rejected or held) version GET /v1/papers/{id}/v/{n}/checks returns the advisory checks report (similarity matches, references) of unlisted versions to anyone
bug.reproduction_steps: Submit and consent a version so it enters moderation and the pipeline extracts its text Anonymously GET /v1/papers/{id}/v/{n}/text -> 200 with all paragraphs; GET .../compare?from=1&to=n -> 200 with its text
bug.expected: For a version whose state is not listed, /text, /compare (when either side is unlisted) and /checks return 404 problem to anonymous callers and to anyone who is not one of the version's authors or a tier-4 moderator; authors and moderators still get the content (moderators need it to review). Listed versions are unchanged
bug.actual: Pre-moderation text and checks are public

constraints.constraint: Use the same "is the caller an author of this version or tier 4" rule the content route uses for unlisted files; resolve the principal from an optional bearer token
Do not move extraction later: moderators rely on the text and checks during moderation
